jagadish.name: Dr. Jagadish Prabhu
jagadish.aboutHeading: Advanced orthopaedic care, grounded in experience.
biography: Dr. Jagadish Prabhu is a highly qualified and experienced Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon with over 17 years of clinical experience in the field of orthopaedics and musculoskeletal healthcare. He is distinguished by his advanced professional qualifications, extensive clinical experience and unwavering commitment to delivering comprehensive, evidence-based orthopaedic care.

His academic and professional credentials include FRCS (Orth & Tr) (UK), MS (Orthopaedics), DNB (Orthopaedics), D.Ortho, FHMS and MBBS, reflecting a strong foundation in orthopaedic surgery and advanced specialist training.

With a patient-centred approach to clinical practice, Dr. Jagadish Prabhu places particular emphasis on accurate diagnosis, individualised treatment planning and optimal functional recovery. He believes that effective orthopaedic care extends beyond treating the condition itself, focusing equally on restoring mobility, relieving pain, preserving joint function and enhancing overall quality of life.

Through his private practice at Dr. Prabhu Orthopaedic and ENT Centre, J.P. Nagar – 8th Phase, Bengaluru, he is committed to providing personalised, ethical and comprehensive orthopaedic healthcare in a professional and compassionate clinical environment.

In addition to his private clinical practice, Dr. Jagadish Prabhu performs orthopaedic surgical procedures at reputed, premier corporate hospitals across South Bengaluru, utilising state-of-the-art surgical infrastructure, advanced medical technology and comprehensive multidisciplinary healthcare facilities.
His practice combines personalised patient care with the clinical expertise and advanced surgical capabilities of leading tertiary-care institutions.

His philosophy of care is founded on three essential principles: clinical excellence, ethical medical practice and patient satisfaction. He strives to ensure that every patient receives the highest standards of professional attention, clear communication and treatment tailored to their individual needs.
His ultimate goal is to help patients overcome musculoskeletal challenges, regain mobility and return to an active, independent and fulfilling life.

shilpa.name: Dr. Shilpa Prabhu
shilpa.title: Senior Consultant ENT Surgeon
shilpa.biography:
Dr. Shilpa Prabhu is a highly experienced Senior Consultant ENT Surgeon with 14 years of clinical experience in the comprehensive diagnosis and management of Ear, Nose and Throat conditions.

With extensive clinical expertise and a patient-centred approach, she is committed to delivering high-quality, ethical and evidence-based ENT care. She believes in providing accurate diagnosis, effective treatment and personalised attention to every patient, ensuring comfort and confidence throughout their treatment journey.

She practises at Dr. Prabhu Orthopaedic and ENT Centre, J.P. Nagar 8th Phase, Bengaluru, and is also involved in providing specialised ENT care and procedures.

faqs.question: What care can I ask about at the centre?
faqs.answer: The centre focuses on orthopaedic and ENT care. The doctor can discuss which evaluation or treatment is suitable for your concern during a consultation.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Use the contact details in the footer to call the centre and ask about available appointment times.

faqs.question: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.answer: Bring any previous prescriptions, test results, scans or X-rays related to your concern, along with a list of medicines you currently take.

faqs.question: Should I bring previous X-rays or scans?
faqs.answer: Yes. Previous imaging and reports can help the doctor understand your history. Bring the original files or clear copies if you have them.

faqs.question: How should I prepare for an ENT consultation?
faqs.answer: Make a note of your symptoms, when they began, how often they happen, and any treatment you have already tried.

faqs.question: Can I ask the doctor about treatment options during the visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can discuss your concerns, possible options, expected follow-up and any questions you have with the doctor.
